name: dana-whitfield-front-door
description: Bringing a parent home: is the medicine list clear? by Dana Whitfield: a Front Door assessment.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your Anthropic API key: it writes each visitor's plan and runs the advisor. Get it at [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com) under **API Keys**, and set a monthly spending limit there under **Settings > Limits**.

DAILY_LIMIT_USD.description: The most the AI may cost in one day, in US dollars. When it's reached, visitors still get their result; the plan and the advisor come back the next day.
